# Invariant token and direct seed with unchecked declarations

A complete Class<T> token and direct T fallback retain one method-scoped result
beside an independent Object input and a declared RuntimeException subtype.
A Type-based delegate preserves the actual token, value, fallback and opaque
result without interpreting or converting their contents. Four frozen routes
compare 96 cases twice for source and SDK providers, compiling every output and
auditing every original entry and metadata. Null/raw tokens and values, callback
mutation, partial effects, exact unchecked and hidden checked failures, and late
caller casts remain observable. Six wrong programs and six Code-preserving
Signature controls guard the proof. Only authored fixtures execute.
